name: Fingerprint Grow → On Enrollment Done
description:
An action to be performed when a fingerprint is enrolled. See [`on_enrollment_done` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow/#fingerprint_grow-on_enrollment_done).

With this configuration option you can write complex automations whenever a finger is successfully enrolled. To use the variables, use a [lambda](https://esphome.io/automations/templates/#config-lambda) template, the slot number enrolled into is available inside that lambda under the variable named `finger_id`.
